howItWorks.heading: How Aapke Liye Prepares Your Relief Claim
howItWorks.subtitle: Designed for low connectivity and zero paperwork. From spoken words to an official SDRF relief claim.
howItWorks.listenStepsAria: Listen to all steps explained aloud
howItWorks.step1Desc: Press the red record button and describe what the water took: your house, crop, livestock, or family documents. No typing required.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Take photos of broken walls, submerged fields, or lost belongings. Automatic GPS coordinates and timestamps confirm authenticity.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Gemini maps your losses to exact SDRF compensation norms and suggests legal proof substitutions for any lost identity papers.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Download your official PDF application. Track your verification timeline step-by-step until DBT relief reaches your bank account.
howItWorks.bannerTime: Takes less than 3 minutes. No internet or documents needed to start.
howItWorks.bannerGemini: Gemini translates your spoken dialect directly into official government SDRF norms.

papersLost.title: When Your Papers Are Lost in the Flood
papersLost.intro3: solely because documents were swept away by floodwaters.
papersLost.intro4: prepares recognized alternative proof packages ready for revenue inspection:
papersLost.card1Solution: Gram Panchayat Pradhan or Ward Councillor attestation letter + emergency biometric re-print token at nearest Seva Kendra.
papersLost.card2Solution: Beneficiary match from local PDS / ration dealer register + Panchayat household family endorsement certificate.
papersLost.card3Solution: State Banglarbhumi / Bhulekh portal digital extract + geo-tagged photos of plot + neighbour witness signature.
papersLost.card4Solution: Aadhaar-seeded DBT direct bank lookup; bank manager certificate using linked mobile number and PMJDY records.

forOfficials.title: For District Magistrates, BDOs, and Revenue Officers
forOfficials.desc: Eliminate paper backlogs after inundation. Inspect GPS geotags, timestamp watermarks, AI damage scores, and cross-claim duplicate photo flags in one consolidated portal.
forOfficials.card1Desc: Lat/lon geofencing matches flood inundation boundaries
forOfficials.card2Desc: Cross-checks photos to prevent double claiming across wards
forOfficials.card3Desc: Single mothers, elderly, & disabled flagged to top of queue
forOfficials.card4Desc: Standard Excel / CSV export matching State Disaster Relief formats

gemini.badge: Transparent AI · Built for Indian Field Conditions
gemini.title: Powered by Google Gemini · Transparent AI
gemini.desc: We use Google Gemini strictly where it solves real barriers for flood-affected families — converting spoken village dialects into verified government claim documents without requiring typing or paperwork:
gemini.card1Desc: Understands spoken accounts in Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil & English. Translates rural idioms into structured SDRF compensation line items (mud wall collapse, submerged paddy, cattle loss).
gemini.card2Desc: Analyzes photos of broken roofs and water marks, outputting plain-text evidentiary reasons and damage levels for inspecting officers instead of arbitrary black-box scores.

track.title: Track Your Relief Claim
track.subtitle: Check real-time verification progress by District Authorities, Field Inspectors, and Direct Bank Transfer (DBT).
track.listenAria: Listen to tracking updates in your language
track.stuckTitle: Statutory Action: Claim In Process > 14 Days
track.stuckDesc: Under Citizen Charter guidelines, flood relief claims must be processed within two weeks. If your relief is pending without field clearance, download pre-formatted legal draft petitions:
track.letter1Desc: Formal notice citing SDRF 2022–26 timeline regulations for urgent sanction.
track.letter2Desc: Pre-drafted complaint for State CMO Grievance / District Magistrate portal.
track.letter3Desc: Statutory Section 6(1) query seeking daily progress inspection sheet.
track.letterTemplate:
To,
The Block Development Officer (BDO) / Sub-Divisional Magistrate,
District Disaster Relief Cell.

Subject: Urgent Sanction of SDRF Relief Claim [Ref: {{claimId}}]

Respected Sir/Madam,
I, {{name}}, submitted my disaster relief claim for total house damage and crop loss. More than 14 days have elapsed since field inspection. As per standard SDRF relief norms, kindly release the pending DBT compensation to avoid ongoing distress to my family.

Claim ID: {{claimId}}
Attached: Geo-tagged photo verification receipt.

prepare.title: విపత్తు పత్రాల వాల్ట్
prepare.subtitle: వరదలు రాకముందే కుటుంబ పత్రాలు, ఇంటి సాధారణ ఫోటోలను భద్రపరచండి. విపత్తు సమయంలో పత్రాల కోసం ఆలస్యం లేకుండా వెంటనే పరిహారం పొందండి.
